reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific new intervention (5 at.% V microalloying of NbMoTaW) that is not studied in any passage. It synthesizes the known ductility problem of NbMoTaW (P13, P26) with the irradiation tolerance mechanisms of other V-containing RHEAs (P3, P6, P27) and the general concept of microalloying for ductility (P7, P12, P18), linking them through a new mechanism of V-induced lattice distortions that simultaneously activate slip systems and modify defect energy landscapes. No passage proposes this specific alloy or this dual mechanism.
